description:
We are NASAPOLLITES, a passionate team of builders, coders, and space enthusiasts taking on the SPHEREx challenge at NASA Space Apps 2026. NASA’s SPHEREx mission maps the entire sky across 102 near-infrared bands, holding the secrets to undiscovered brown dwarfs, comets, asteroids, and variable stars, but the sheer volume of data is far too vast for any single team of astronomers to sift through alone.

Our mission is to bridge that gap by building an intuitive, public-facing web tool! :)
